purpose: Implement approved S12 memory confirmation/candidate/latest and monotonic-cutoff storage + DTOs, focused self-tests. No chat-threads.ts or central API edits.
body: Targets existing packages/db/src/profile-facts.ts proposeProfileFact/discardProposal/decideProfileFact/readStudentMemoryRevision, packages/db/src/index.ts, packages/db/tests/student-store.test.ts and packages/schemas/src/student-api.ts with its existing tests. Retained cutoff counterexample is in qa/evidence/quest-closeout-cycle2-cutoff-counterexample.txt. Keep confirmed row.value active. Add bounded pendingChange in same row: {candidateId:string,version:string,value:string,proposedAt:string,quote?:string,sourceLang?:string,threadId?:string,turnId?:string}; internal base revision allowed. Expose optional pendingChange on ProposedFact and MemoryItem DTOs (same fields without identity internals). Initial proposed rows also have pendingChange and retain existing top-level value/status for compatibility. Decision schema adds reject,candidateId,expectedVersion; replacements require exact binding; stale throws existing ProfileFactChanged; reject removes only candidate, erase removes row. Keep legacy first-proposal confirm/value and correction/erase compatible. No stale extraction overwrite of confirmed values, no later old candidate can overwrite newer user decision. Add exported readStudentMemorySnapshot(db,studentId): Promise<{revision:string;historyAfter:string|null;historyUsable:boolean}> and export via existing db barrel; existing readStudentMemoryRevision remains string and shares validated snapshot logic. New monotonic decision cutoff is advanced only by explicit decisions ($max server time), never proposal cleanup. No-marker historyUsable=true; legacy marker without reliable cutoff historyUsable=false. Pending/uncertain decisions or compensations still refuse. Preserve real erasure/fences, owner bounds, redaction and provenance. Coordinate new signatures in evidence early; API peer will consume these exact DTOs; do not edit its files. Run meaningful red-before/green-after existing tests including T0 extraction/T1 chat/T2 forget/successful cleanup, candidate reject/replace/stale/CAS and overlapping confirmations. Existing fakes may lack $max; change only if needed in packages/db/tests/fakes.ts and name it in evidence before editing (root grants this additional existing helper).
estimate: Approved S12 owned contribution; finite 40min envelope with closeout, T057 prior cycle2 history retained. Not independent feature acceptance.
acceptance: Implement all owned approved behavior in place; preserve disjoint peer work.
Focused affected tests and typecheck with commands/results and exact interfaces in evidence; no self-certification.
checks: Run focused existing test files; no unfiltered/full suite, DB or provider network.
